label: RB260GSP
description: MikroTik RB260GSP (CSS106-1G-4P-1S) — 5x 1G RJ45, 1x SFP, passive PoE-out on Ether2-Ether5.
notes: Vendor figures from the MikroTik product page specification table (read 2026-11-21): 'PoE-out ports Ether2-Ether5', 'PoE out Passive PoE', 'Low voltage PoE-Out current limit 1 A', 'Max total out (A) 2 A', and 'Number of DC inputs 2 (DC jack, PoE-IN)' with 'PoE in Passive PoE' at 11-30 V. Ether1 is the power inlet and does not source; the four outlets are Ether2-Ether5. This is the product-code entry for the same box as devices/mikrotik/rb260gsp.json (research/rb260gsp-two-entries.md).

poe.note: MikroTik publishes current limits only: PoE-out on Ether2-Ether5, passive PoE, 1 A per port and 'Max total out (A) 2 A' against an 11-30 V input window. No watt figure is printed, and 2 A x the input voltage is arithmetic the vendor did not do, so the budget stays unknown rather than invented.
